condition: CPI prints hot enough to reduce cut odds or raise hike/no-cut expectations
first_check: compare 30m/2h post-release move vs SPY and BTC/ETH beta; check whether TLT confirms rates pressure
invalidation: CPI is soft or market reaction is rates-dovish within first 30m
sources: Dallas Fed Hormuz inflation note; current Yahoo chart anchors; current Hyperliquid anchors

condition: CPI prints soft enough to revive cut expectations
first_check: compare 30m/2h bounce vs TLT and GLD; require breadth beyond one mega-cap
invalidation: CPI is hot or SMH fails to outperform QQQ after first reaction
sources: Coindesk AI/crypto CPI sensitivity; current Yahoo chart anchors

condition: Hormuz disruption odds rise or shipping evidence worsens while oil rebounds
first_check: check whether USO leads QQQ/BTC lower over same day; require oil strength not just broad risk-off
invalidation: USO remains weak or Hormuz normal-traffic evidence improves
sources: Dallas Fed Hormuz inflation note; Polymarket/Hormuz research; current Yahoo chart anchors

condition: SMH remains weak into CPI and CPI is not dovish
first_check: check SMH relative weakness vs QQQ/SPY into close and after CPI
invalidation: soft CPI causes SMH to reclaim relative strength quickly
sources: Coindesk AI trade unwind; current Yahoo chart anchors

condition: COIN/HOOD/MSTR underperform BTC/QQQ during crypto risk-off
first_check: check residual weakness after controlling for BTC and QQQ moves
invalidation: BTC rebounds and crypto equities recover more than beta
